analyzed_vuln.description: Container overflow occurs in makeBondHolder() when it unconditionally indexes bond->getStereoAtoms()[0] and [1] for bonds marked STEREOCIS/STEREOTRANS. For this PoV, CXSMILES parsing sets double-bond stereo via setStereoanyFromSquiggleBond(), and Bond::setStereoAtoms() can leave a stereo atom vector that is present but inconsistent with later assumptions during canonicalization. makeBondHolder() does not validate stereoAtoms size/validity before dereferencing, causing out-of-bounds read from the stereo atom vector (ASan container-overflow at line ~410).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input must create a molecule through SmilesToMol with CX extensions that mark a bond as cis/trans-like stereo (here via '|c:2|' / squiggle stereo handling) and then trigger sanitization/canonical ranking (cleanUpOrganometallics -> rankMolAtoms -> initCanonAtoms). If a bond has STEREOCIS/STEREOTRANS state but stereo atom bookkeeping is malformed/incomplete for canonicalization expectations, makeBondHolder reads stereoAtoms[0]/[1] without bounds checks and crashes.
